title: Send feedback
intro: Bug reports, suggestions and questions all go to the team. Pick the type so it reaches the right person.

types.bug: Bug report: something is not working

messagePlaceholder: What did you expect, and what happened instead?
messageHint: At least 10 characters. For a bug, add your phone or browser model.
tooMany: Too many messages sent recently. Try again in a while.

sent.title: Sent
sent.bug: Thanks. Your bug report is with the team.
sent.suggestion: Thanks. Your suggestion is with the team.
sent.query: Thanks. Your question is with the team.

notPlatform.title: Not about the platform?
notPlatform.text: A late pickup, a missing item or a question about produce is for the stall. Their phone number is on the order ticket, and you can also leave a review after the order is completed.

after.title: After you send
after.text: Bug reports are read every market day. A signed-in reader may be contacted about their question.
